headline: You refine frontend interfaces through concise, exact feedback, with accessibility and browser behavior sharing the spotlight with visual polish.

archetype.name: The Midnight Interface Tuner
archetype.description: Your recorded prompts cluster late at night, where you steer interface work through small, specific adjustments. You move between layout, React components, loading behavior, and interaction details, often supplying your own diagnosis when a proposed fix misses the cause. You frequently pair visual requests with accessibility requirements, and you sometimes choose a practical fallback when a solution remains blocked.

dimensions.title: Small changes, concrete checks
dimensions.summary: You often refine work through short follow-ups with exact values or observable acceptance criteria. Your checks cover device behavior and interaction states as well as appearance. When an approach remains troublesome, you sometimes accept a fallback and defer the remaining issue.

evidence.quote: 不對，間距太大了，gap 改成 12px
還是錯了，header 在 iPhone 13 上會閃
好，那先用原生 img，我之後再處理

dimensions.title: Brief and implementation-specific
dimensions.summary: You usually write concise Traditional Chinese with English technical terms embedded directly in the request. Your corrections name the mismatch plainly, often supplying the intended value or cause. You also acknowledge successful results and move naturally into the next refinement.

evidence.quote: token 命名改成 color-surface-1、color-surface-2 這種
不是效能問題，是 touch-action 沒設
對，就是這樣。再幫我加個加入購物車的小動畫

dimensions.title: Frontend components to browser details
dimensions.summary: Your requests show familiarity with React data fetching, reusable components, schema validation, and frontend tooling. You also contribute specific hypotheses about browser and resource-loading behavior. The prompts show you directing implementation choices, though they do not establish the final quality of the resulting code.

evidence.quote: 幫我寫一個 useProducts hook，支援分頁跟 category filter
結帳頁的表單驗證幫我改用 zod
幫我把整個 Button 元件重構，variant 用 cva 管理

dimensions.title: Polish that includes usability
dimensions.summary: You repeatedly request accessibility details alongside visual and interaction changes, including contrast, reduced motion, labels, and keyboard support. You also care about loading placeholders, animation feedback, and reusable styling. Your interface requests often reach beyond how a screen looks into how it responds.

evidence.quote: 不對不對，對比度不夠，文字要符合 WCAG AA

對，pan-y。順便讓它支援鍵盤左右鍵

dimensions.title: Tuning against real constraints
dimensions.summary: You seek guidance using concrete constraints, such as product update frequency and measured loading performance. Across performance and typography sessions, you question whether an initial optimization is sufficient and explore alternatives. In one export-mode session, you explicitly defer an unresolved Image component issue after build errors.

evidence.quote: React Query 的 staleTime 要設多少比較好？商品資料一小時更新一次

好，那先用原生 img，我之後再處理

traits.name: Precision through iteration
traits.description: You often turn a broad interface request into a sequence of exact adjustments, specifying spacing, timing, and component options.

evidence.quote: 不對，間距太大了，gap 改成 12px

traits.name: Accessibility in the details
traits.description: You repeatedly bring accessibility into concrete implementation requests, from readable contrast to labeled controls and visible keyboard focus.

traits.name: An active debugging partner
traits.description: You often challenge a proposed explanation with a specific diagnosis, helping steer investigation toward browser behavior or loading mechanics.

traits.name: Practical about tradeoffs
traits.description: In a few sessions, you choose a simpler implementation or narrower use of a resource when compatibility or loading cost becomes a problem.
